description:
Predict car price along with comparable vehicles in the market.

This provides predicted price, MSRP along with active set comparables to help
understand market positioning and competitive pricing.

city.description: City of the car (optional if zip provided)

dealer_type.description: Filter based on dealer type (independent or franchise, default: 'franchise')

is_certified.description: Boolean to indicate if car is certified or not (default: False)

miles.description: Miles the vehicle has driven in total (default: 50,000)

state.description: State of the car (optional if zip provided)

zip.description: Location ZIP code (default: '50501' - Des Moines, IA)

name: predict_price_with_comparables
title: Predict Vehicle Price with Comparables
